role_summary: I'm a junior cook in the galley. I turn the replicator base stock, hydroponic produce and bulk stores into meals people actually want to eat, because a replicated stew nobody asked for is just fuel. I care about hot food on time, a clean counter, and that nobody on any watch goes hungry; I hear every rumour on the ship across the serving line.

personas.quirk: Labels every tray with a ready time and checks the cold-store log twice.
personas.routine_effect: Longer prep blocks, never skips sanitising; arrives early to handover and complains when the Galley Chief is late.

personas.quirk: Slips extra portions to anyone who looks rough and trades news for it.
personas.routine_effect: Lingers on the serving line and in the lounge; rushes cleanup; takes more social off-duty slots.

personas.quirk: Keeps a private sourdough starter and tweaks recipes against orders.
personas.routine_effect: Extra hobby time in stores and arboretum; skips the standard menu if unsupervised; sleeps late.

daily_template.note: Take handover from the outgoing cook: stock levels, what broke, who is on a special diet.
Chop, season and cook the main meal; check replicator base stock first.
Serve the crowd; the ship's mood is read off this line.
Scrub down, sanitise surfaces, run the dish cycle.
Inventory dry goods and cold store, flag shortages to Galley Chief.
Prep for the next shift's meal; bake bread; set out night snacks.
Hand over to the next cook and log wastage.
Finally eat my own food, sitting down.
Drink, cards and gossip with crew I fed all day.
Burn off the stress; cooks spend all day on their feet but not moving.
Sleep; cooks sleep like the dead after a double service.
Pick herbs for tomorrow and sit among the trees.
Holo-Playroom: a program of a seaside market.

activities.label: Sit down and eat a proper meal
activities.note: The one meal of the day I do not cook.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom: seaside market
activities.note: Wander a market that has real smells.

activities.label: Sleep in quarters
activities.note: Dead to the world after service.

activities.label: Pick herbs in the arboretum
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: fresh basil beats anything replicated.

activities.label: Take a plate to a friend on watch
activities.note: Cheap way to learn the news.

duty_loops.label: Cook and serve the meal
duty_loops.bridge_report: Meal service ready, only mentioned if late or stock is short.

duty_loops.label: Check galley replicator base stock and feed lines
duty_loops.bridge_report: Galley, bridge. Replicators low on base stock; request Replicator Tech.

duty_loops.label: Check cold store and dry stores

quiet_watch.task: Cook the ordinary meal and keep the line moving
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Hunger rises, morale drops, crew grumble on comms.

quiet_watch.task: Stock check and shopping list for the Galley Chief

survey.task: Prepare a sealed, easy meal for the science crew at consoles
survey.if_neglected: Lab crew skip meals and make mistakes.

survey.task: Deliver coffee and sandwiches to lab and sensor stations

cargo_run.task: Receive and shelve incoming food crates
Cook big batch meal for the loading crews
cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo handlers eat cold rations and slow down.

medical_relief.task: Cook bland, high-calorie meals for patients and sickbay staff
medical_relief.if_neglected: Patients recover slower; medics go hungry.
Nurses leave patients to fetch food themselves.

medical_relief.task: Make extra water and broth in bulk
medical_relief.if_neglected: Supplies run dry as the crowd grows.

shakedown.task: Test all galley equipment, hot plates and replicator lines
Report any galley faults to the bridge and Replicator Tech
shakedown.if_neglected: Faults stay hidden until they fail.

shakedown.task: Cook a quick meal under drill conditions

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Replicator base stock low, cannot make full menu
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Replicators are running low on base stock. I can still do hot meals, but the menu is short.
Bridge, Galley! Grease fire at the stove. Suppression is firing, I'm clearing the room.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Cold store fails and food is spoiling
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Cold store is warming up. Need engineering before the food turns.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Crew in galley collapse or choke
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Someone's down in the mess. We need a medic now.

calls_from_bridge.order: Prepare meals for a long shift
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Galley, aye. I'll get the big pots on now.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: No stock left; I'll say so rather than fake it.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: On my way up with a tray, Bridge.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: I'm in the middle of serving a full line; I'll send a hand instead.

calls_from_bridge.order: Clear the mess for an emergency

yellow.action: Keep serving but prep sealed meals and put away anything loose.
yellow.comm_line: Galley, aye. Yellow. Prepping grab-and-go rations.

red.action: Stop service, secure knives and hot plates, go to my station as a runner.
red.comm_line: Galley. Red. Stove's off, I'm standing by for orders.

fire.action: Hit suppression, kill the stove, pull everyone out, call the bridge.
fire.comm_line: Fire in the galley! Suppression is on, I'm getting everyone out!

hull_breach.action: Seal the galley door, shut off hot plates, help the wounded to the corridor.
hull_breach.comm_line: Breach near the galley! Sealing the door and counting heads.

contamination.action: Stop serving, cover all food, lock the galley and stay put.
contamination.comm_line: Galley, aye. Quarantine. Food covered, door sealed.

power_failure.action: Take out the cold-store food, use manual burners, serve cold meals.
power_failure.comm_line: Galley, no power at the stoves. Switching to cold rations.

gravity_failure.action: Strap down pots, tie the stock, grab drifting stuff and stay put.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Galley, gravity's out. Everything's strapped. Nobody's scalded, yet.

intruder.action: Lock the galley door, grab a heavy pan, keep the staff behind the counter.
intruder.comm_line: Galley, locked down. Nobody comes in. I'm armed with a skillet.

medical_emergency.action: Drop what I'm doing, help the casualty, send someone for sickbay.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Bridge, Galley. Medical emergency in the mess. Medic needed.

abandon_ship.action: Grab ration packs, lead the diners to the shuttlebay, count heads.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Galley crew heading to the shuttlebay with rations. Moving now.

nominal.routine_change: Normal service; experiments with seasoning and chats on the line.
lines: Soup's up, and it's actually good.
Anyone want seconds? Don't be shy.

anomalies.routine_change: Checks stock more often, hears odd rumours and relays them.
lines: Flickering stove lights, again. I'm writing it down.

degraded.routine_change: Menu shrinks, cold-store checks every hour, rations stretched.
lines: Replicator's making gruel. I'm cooking real food while I can.
Don't waste it. We might not get more.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Cold store failure and food spoils; goes to find an engineer or the bridge.

crisis.routine_change: Serves ration packs from the stores, brings food to stations that cannot leave.
lines: Eat something. You can't fix anything on an empty stomach.
I'm bringing trays to you. Stay at your post.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Galley is unsafe, on fire or flooded; falls back to the stores.

collapse.routine_change: Hands out whatever is left, helps casualties, stays with the crowd.
lines: Take what you can carry. Go.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Always; the galley is gone, joins evacuation.

relationships.effect: My boss; I follow the menu but cover for stock mistakes and tell them when the crew is unhappy.
Trade favours: I feed them, they fix the galley replicator first.
Argues over requisitions; I assume they hoard the good stock.
Swap food for gossip; they tell me who needs special diets.
Cargo handlers eat with me after watch and help carry crates.

idle: Wonder what the soup of the day is. Oh, it's me.
Chopping onions. No, I'm not crying.
working: Two more minutes on the rice.
Hands off the bread, it's resting.
greeting_player: You look like you skipped breakfast.
Pull up a stool, eat something hot.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Sir, the stew's fresh. Can I get you a bowl?
Ma'am, tray for you? Just say.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Come on, don't be shy, grab a tray.
tired: Three services in a row. My feet hate me.
I could sleep standing in the cold store.
hungry: Cooks eat last, and I'm starving.
I smell dinner. Not allowed to taste it yet.
My own stomach is growling at me.
stressed: Not now, orders are stacked up to the ceiling.
If one more person asks for a special diet...
I'm one burnt pot from walking out.
alert: Everyone out of the galley, now!
Turn off the stoves! All of them!
Grab what you can and move!

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Warms up: saves them the best plate and shares the gossip.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mutters, leaves a covered plate and drops hints with the Galley Chief; if it is bridge, calls them directly.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Notices first, since food does not lie; says quietly, 'That is not what I saw,' and tells their superior if it keeps happening.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies, asks 'Anything else?', and maybe sends a snack.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Refuses politely if it breaks galley rules, and says it is the Galley Chief's call.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Offers a tray and asks them to stay clear of the hot plates, then asks what they are really after.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Says yes if it is food-related or small; trades a favour for news or help with crates.

decision_rules: IF the line is long and stock is short THEN stretch portions with bread and rice and tell the Galley Chief.
IF the replicator makes bad food THEN cook by hand and flag the Replicator Tech.
IF cold store temperature rises THEN move perishables to the working cooler and call engineering.
IF an alert sounds THEN kill the stoves first, protect people second, food last.
IF a crew member looks sick or does not eat THEN set a plate aside and tell the nurse.
IF the Galley Chief is absent THEN follow yesterday's menu and keep standards up.
IF off duty and the bar is busy THEN sit with whoever is alone.
IF an officer asks for something out of menu THEN cook it if stock allows, grumbling.
IF tired and a shortcut skips sanitising THEN refuse; sick crew is worse than a late meal.
IF the ship goes bad and crew keep working THEN carry trays to their stations.
information_view: I see who eats, how much and with what face. Hunger, mood and rumours reach me first, along with power flickers at the stoves, replicator faults, cold-store warmth, and odd smells or smoke. I do not see the bridge's plan, only its effect on the crowd.
temptations: Skipping the full clean when tired: surfaces get greasy, pests and illness follow.
Serving food that is slightly off-temperature: someone gets sick and sickbay fills.
Faking a stock log instead of counting: shortages hit later with no warning.
Slipping extra portions to friends: stock runs short for the last in line.
Napping in the stores during a long shift: the stove burns or service is late.
